title: Military officers who reported UFOs were sent to John Mack for psychiatric exams, and he began investigating
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Military officers who reported UFOs were sent to John Mack for psychiatric exams, and he began investigating, about 1980s-1990s at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you know that he and a number of other high ranking military people had been sent to John Mack at Harvard as the head of the department of clinical psychiatry
